question_text: A heavy 10 kg iron ball and a light 1 kg wooden ball are dropped simultaneously from the same height in an evacuated vacuum chamber. Which ball hits the ground first?
correct_answer_and_steps: Both hit the ground at the exact same instant. Acceleration due to gravity g = G*M_earth / R^2 is independent of the falling object's mass m. topic_concept: Force on Charges and Current in Magnetic Field
question_text: An electron moves horizontally from West to East into a uniform magnetic field directed vertically downwards. Find force direction.
correct_answer_and_steps: Electron moves West to East, so current I is East to West. B is Down. By Fleming's Left-Hand Rule: Forefinger (Field) = Down, Center (Current) = West => Thumb (Force) points South. For stationary proton, v = 0 so F = 0 N.
student_response: From the formula, The stationary proton is repelled by North pole because North is positive charge. as calculated.
misconception_label: MISC-MAG-001: Magnetic Pole = Electrostatic Charge Fallacy
evidence_details: Equates magnetic pole to electrostatic charge.
diagram_description: Magnetic field B directed downwards. Electron travels West to East. Conventional current points East to West. Force points South.
